notes.title: BurnerSphere Update – Version 0.19.0
notes.notes:
Welcome back to the Playa! Version 0.19.0 brings new features, smoother experiences, and more magic to explore in BurnerSphere:  

:sparkles: Worlds & Venues  
- Streaming World portal has been moved — it’s now placed directly in front of you as you enter Center Camp, making it easier than ever to dive in  
- New maps and portals to help you explore more easily

:newspaper: News & Events  
- News Board now supports timed updates and event announcements  
- New in-world signs and announcements to keep you in the loop  

:art: Art & Visuals  
- Updated art assets and shaders for a cleaner, more immersive look  
- Annotations improved so you can better engage with creative pieces  

:tools: Bug Fixes
- Credits page added in Settings to recognize contributors  
- Automatic recovery systems to reduce disruptions  
- Networking and streaming improvements for more reliable play  

Time of Day (New Feature!)
- Certain worlds now shift naturally with the time of day, adding a whole new layer of immersion  
- Currently available in a few select scenes, but this feature will be gradually rolled out across more of BurnerSphere  

:sparkles: See you on the digital Playa — don’t forget your sparkle! :sparkles:
